bounds: Actual future browser proof uses the owned disposable production Next/native V2 fixture, actual password/MFA UI, canonical organization binding, live primary authority and one explicit synthetic grievance entitlement.
No QA session cookies, response fulfillment/stubs, provider email, staging target or production target are used.
The browser module requires all named checks in all four profiles plus successful cleanup and zero browser/server/external-request errors. Unexecuted checks remain unexecuted.

Required actual browser checks include real single-membership auto-binding and explicit multiple-membership UI selection, EN/FR control names and invalid-MFA feedback, keyboard authentication/reopening, persisted intake, deadline create/reschedule/complete/cancel and audit, denied member mutations without side effects, other-member/foreign-tenant/finance denials and revoked real sessions.
No physical-device, additional-browser-engine, full-WCAG, live inbox, complete stakeholder or whole-release qualification is asserted.
Next defaults to 4096 MB per Node process; explicit 1024–8192 MB overrides are validated and recorded. This is not a whole-host memory limit.

Disk admission requires 2 GiB before source copying and build launch. A 5-second watcher cancels the owned process group below 1 GiB and records incomplete proof. Live low-disk cancellation has not been exercised in this source batch.
Next state/HOME is a uniquely owned sibling outside the copied workspace. Progress output is redacted and retained separately; snapshot/state cleanup remain independent of progress-log write success.

sourceConfirmedFindingsAndRepairs.finding: Password/MFA authentication creates an unbound session; LoginForm navigated directly to the dashboard whose canonical layout requires a selected organization.
sourceConfirmedFindingsAndRepairs.evidence: packages/platform-auth/src/mfa/service.ts createSession; lib/auth/canonical-organization-selection.ts getCanonicalOrganizationChoices; app/[locale]/dashboard/layout.tsx canonical context requirement.
sourceConfirmedFindingsAndRepairs.repair: Read the real canonical choices after authentication; retain a valid active selection, auto-bind only one offered active membership, require an accessible explicit EN/FR choice for multiple, and refuse zero/failed/contradictory/stale choices without dashboard navigation.

sourceConfirmedFindingsAndRepairs.finding: The workload fixture producer returned unbound MFA cookies and passed them to withBearerOrgBinding, which explicitly rejects sessions without organizationId.
sourceConfirmedFindingsAndRepairs.repair: The shared producer authenticates through the real password/MFA endpoints, executes the real canonical organization switch, verifies the authority/resource confirmation and rotated cookie, and returns only the bound issued cookie.
